fields.statement: QA claude-code-6b7d70a1 at ccf01f58d, hands-on with a built rhiza binary on PATH (fake gh/rex/claude from run-ship-land-conflict.txtar, bare origin, hermetic HOME). HEAD's binary cannot get a ship-change run past build/check (actor reuse, see the blocker on actor-record-no-duplicate), so these runs used HEAD built with only that reuse loop removed; the code under test here is HEAD's unchanged. Case 1: head build refuses the first land with exit 3 'cannot land change set X: node N changed' after main moved feature.txt; rhiza run status shows land fail -> land-triage -> land-conflict-triage -> land-main-conflict-triage pass -> conflict-fix (1 fixer session) -> land visit 2 pass, never conflict-fix-landed; two head-build land calls, gh pr merge ran, change set landed. Case 2 (exit 3, other message): run fails at land-main-conflict-triage, no fixer session.

QA claude-code-6b7d70a1 at ccf01f58d, hands-on with a built rhiza binary on PATH (fake gh/rex/claude from run-ship-land-conflict.txtar, bare origin, hermetic HOME). HEAD's binary cannot get a ship-change run past build/check (actor reuse, see the blocker on actor-record-no-duplicate), so these runs used HEAD built with only that reuse loop removed; the code under test here is HEAD's unchanged. Fake gh pr create failing 'HTTP 502: Bad Gateway' twice: open-pr passed on the third call, the failures 2s apart. Failing four times: open-pr failed after waits of 2s, 6s, 18s with 'HTTP 502: Bad Gateway ... (after 3 retries)' and the run failed at open-pr-triage. go test ./internal/api -run ShipGHRetry ok.

HEAD's binary cannot get a ship-change run past build/check (actor reuse, see the blocker on actor-record-no-duplicate), so these runs used HEAD built with only that reuse loop removed; the code under test here is HEAD's unchanged. In the run worktree, pushed an origin-only commit to origin's cs/ship-it and made a local-only commit; RHIZA_RUN=... rhiza ship open-pr merged it ('Merge origin/cs/ship-it into cs/ship-it') and pushed plainly: origin's graph keeps e8ffb16 Origin-only commit. Then a conflicting origin commit on clash.txt: open-pr refused 'origin's cs/ship-it has commits that conflict with ...: b9e3c70 Origin clash', no MERGE_HEAD, local HEAD unchanged, origin untouched.

Fake rex failing 'rex: server not answering' on its first two calls: the builder's tab opened on the third call (waits 1s, 3s) and the run reached sign-off. Rex always failing: four calls at 0s, +1s, +3s, +9s, then the run failed 'rex could not open the session's tab: ... server not answering (after 3 retries)'. go test ./internal/api -run SessionRun ok.
